pr_title: Use description key instead of name for Tibber RT unique ID
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

<https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/108797/files> removed the name key, which was used to generate unique IDs for real-time sensors.

This PR moves it to to see the description key instead.
As this key is not a 1:1 in most entities, a migration has been added.
